audit_scope_note: Statistics computed directly from delivered files. Raw rasters, raw POWER JSON and pipeline scripts are NOT in the package, so raw-level checks rely on reports/status_*.json and download_log.json (reported, not re-verified).

datasets.source: NASADEM_HGT v001 (NASA LP DAAC), 1 arc-second; raw tile n27e028 cropped to bbox

geographic_bounds.coordinate_system: Source EPSG:4326 (WGS84 lon/lat). Terrain grid: local transverse Mercator, metres.

resolution.resampling: area average (rasterio Resampling.average) onto square metre grid

datasets.vertical_reference: Vertical datum not recorded in any project file (assumed orthometric height per DATASET_INVENTORY, not verified).

verified_by_audit: complete regular grid at stated spacing
summary n/min/max/mean/std match CSV within 4-decimal rounding
NaN pattern equals kernel border exactly

known_limitations: Border cells have NaN slope/aspect/roughness/TRI (1-cell kernel edge) and NaN elev_variability_std (2-cell edge); this is expected, not data loss.
CSV columns carry no units; units (metres, degrees) are only stated in summaries/README.
Aspect is defined (non-NaN) on near-flat cells where it is physically meaningless.
Raw source rasters are not in the delivered ZIP, so source-to-processed values could not be re-derived in this audit.
Elevation is relative to a body-specific reference; absolute elevations are not comparable across Earth/Mars/Moon.
Earth min elevation in raw status report is -33.0 m but processed 120 m minimum is -2.4 m; raw tile not available to check whether this is a real pit or an artefact.
30 m source averaged by 4x (120 m) or 12x (360 m): smoothing differs from Moon (about 1x).

datasets.source: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic 20 m (USGS Astrogeology), M20_JezeroCrater_CTXDEM_20m.tif

geographic_bounds.coordinate_system: Source: projected CRS on Mars 2000 sphere. Terrain grid: local transverse Mercator on the same sphere, metres. lon/lat are Mars-sphere coordinates, NOT WGS84.

resolution.resampling: area average (rasterio Resampling.average) onto square metre grid

datasets.vertical_reference: Elevation relative to MOLA-localised reference per USGS catalog (secondary: DATASET_INVENTORY); exact reference not stated in project files.

verified_by_audit: complete regular grid at stated spacing
summary n/min/max/mean/std match CSV within 4-decimal rounding
NaN pattern equals kernel border exactly

known_limitations: Border cells have NaN slope/aspect/roughness/TRI (1-cell kernel edge) and NaN elev_variability_std (2-cell edge); this is expected, not data loss.

Elevation is relative to a body-specific reference; absolute elevations are not comparable across Earth/Mars/Moon.

verified_by_audit: valid_cells and all 8 statistics equal the 120 m summary JSONs to 4 decimals

known_limitations: Only 120 m; no 360 m rows.
